topic: Being less harsh (companion Reel, off grid)
caption:
Being kinder to yourself is not always the first step.

Research on self-compassion suggests the harsh way we treat ourselves is more closely linked with distress than the kind side. Turning that harsh voice down can be its own step, and for many people a more reachable one.

The short version of this week's carousel. The full carousel is on our profile, and the full article is linked in bio.

Sources:
Muris, P., & Petrocchi, N. (2017). Protection or vulnerability? A meta-analysis of the relations between the positive and negative components of self-compassion and psychopathology. Clinical Psychology & Psychotherapy. https://doi.org/10.1002/cpp.2005
